text:
Lila (marketing): Quick ask  we need a trimmed battlecard slice for the launch post + webinar. Topline: one sharp takedown vs cloud endpoints, two measurable econ bullets (steady tokens/sec, post-cache $/token), and an inbound routing play that reps can use immediately.
Omar (field): Yes. Keep rebut copy short: 'Buying GPUs is step one; running reliable inference is a whole product.' Add a datapoint about maintenance burden.
Sana (product): Can we avoid the usual 'predictable' wording? Suggest: "deterministic p95 under load" + a numeric example. Also request: include quantized performance.
Hector (research): I pulled fresh numbers from harness bench-2026-03: hosted unbatched p95 ~110ms, batched(16) p95 ~42ms, dedicated sustained ~3300 tokens/s per GPU (fp16), int8 ~1.7x throughput. I'll attach CSV.
ci-bot: bench metadata: bench_id=bench-2026-03, owner=Hector, ts=1829988000.
Omar (field): For inbound routing, let's use ARR buckets (makes more sense for AE routing):
- PoC: <$2k/mo (~<20k tokens) -> SDR trial flow
- Growth: $2k-20k/mo (~20k-200k tokens) -> SDR + AE intro
- Mission: >$20k/mo or compliance -> AE + SE
Include a single-line play for each.
Lila (marketing): Nice. For the one-liner takedown vs cloud APIs: keep it provable: 'Cloud LLM APIs are general access; Redwood adds serving primitives (rollouts, KV cache, routing, observability) that reduce unit cost at scale.' Short and citation-ready.
Sana (product): Add a tiny ops counter: DIY teams typically underestimate rollout+tracing+cache dev work  estimate ~3-6 FTE-months. Use cautious language.
Hector (research): I'll provide two microcharts: 1) p95 comparison (unbatched vs batched) 2) failover microbenchmark: throttle primary region and show fallback latency. Also include quantized rows.
Omar (field): Reps asked for a quick objection script when customer says 'we can build it cheaper' -> 'We ran a TCO: infra + 4-6 months eng + ongoing ops > committed capacity pricing. We can walk you through it.'
Lila (marketing): For the webinar demo, propose "serve-first vignette": live routing policy swap (region -> cost-tier) and cost dashboard that updates with cache hits. Need someone to own the demo script and slides.
Sana (product): I'll own the slides and demo flow. Hector, send charts and the CSVs by EOD. Omar, can you draft the routing YAML snippet and 2-line customer anecdote?
Omar (field): Draft snippet below (for the slide):
```json
{"routing_policy": ["region_priority", "fallback: cost_tier"], "model_variants": ["fp16", "int8"], "cache": "prefix_kv"}
```
Anecdote: non-confidential: "Customer X switched to variant fallback during a regional outage and sustained 90% of throughput; cost fell after enabling KV cache."
Hector (research): Sending CSVs now. Note: please cite bench_id in any public materials. I'll include a tiny appendix with methodology.
legal-bot: Reminder: Any comparative claims must reference bench_id and avoid absolutes. Draft will be routed to Legal for quick review.
Lila (marketing): Timeline: slides + demo script Tue noon, battlecard draft Tue EOD, legal check Wed AM, final by Wed EOD. I'll book a 30-min review Tue 4pm.
Sana (product): One last request: add an 'evidence' appendix slide that lists bench_id and minimal harness notes. Makes Legal happier.
Lila (marketing): Agreed. Thanks everyone. Short, factual, and field-ready copy only. :sparkles:
